metadata.question: Did Dry Chaco forest cover decrease by more than 10% between 2000 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need forest cover data for Dry Chaco region - Compare 2000 vs 2019 - Hansen Global Forest Change dataset is ideal for this (has tree cover and loss layers) - Dry Chaco spans parts of Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia - Will use a defined geometry for Dry Chaco region 2. Masking strategy: - Use tree cover threshold (>30% typically defines forest) - Calculate forest area in 2000 - Calculate forest loss between 2000-2019 - Compute percentage change 3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid result: Actual forest area calculations with reasonable values - C1: If no data available (unlikely with Hansen) - C2: If valid pixel count is 0 after processing - C3: If calculations return None/NaN or unreasonable percentages - A: If decrease > 10% - B: If decrease ≤ 10% ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Dry Chaco region (approximate extent) const dryChaco = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-65.0, -27.5], [-65.0, -19.0], [-57.0, -19.0], [-57.0, -27.5], [-65.0, -27.5]] ]); // Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // Get tree cover in year 2000 (percentage) const treeCover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); // Get loss year (1-23 for 2001-2023) const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // Create forest mask (>30% tree cover) const forestMask2000 = treeCover2000.gte(30); // Calculate initial forest area in 2000 const forest2000 = forestMask2000.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const stats2000 = forest2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: dryChaco, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2000 = stats2000.getInfo(); if (!area2000 || !area2000.treecover2000) { console.log("No data available for Dry Chaco"); console.log("C1"); return; } const forest2000Area = area2000.treecover2000; // Check for valid pixels if (forest2000Area === 0) { console.log("No valid forest pixels in 2000"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Create mask for forest loss between 2001-2019 (lossyear 1-19) const loss2000to2019 = lossYear.gte(1).and(lossYear.lte(19)).and(forestMask2000); // Calculate forest loss area const forestLoss = loss2000to2019.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const statsLoss = forestLoss.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: dryChaco, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const lossData = statsLoss.getInfo(); if (!lossData || lossData.lossyear === undefined) { console.log("Loss calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } const lossArea = lossData.lossyear; // Calculate percentage decrease const percentDecrease = (lossArea / forest2000Area) * 100; // Convert to km² const forest2000Km2 = forest2000Area / 1e6; const lossKm2 = lossArea / 1e6; // Validation if (percentDecrease < 0 || percentDecrease > 100 || isNaN(percentDecrease)) { console.log("Invalid percentage calculation"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Forest 2000: ${forest2000Km2.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`Loss 2000-2019: ${lossKm2.toFixed(0)} km²`); console.log(`Decrease: ${percentDecrease.toFixed(2)}%`); if (percentDecrease > 10) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
